mqar.target_mask: answer token only at every query position

palindrome.layout: random content, separator token 0, exact reversed content

stack.target_mask: value token following every valid POP stack identifier

data.training_generation: deterministic on-the-fly batches keyed by run seed and optimizer step
data.validation_generation: fixed deterministic batches disjoint by seed

discovery.schedule: cosine to zero over the maximum step horizon

interpretation_rules: The learning-rate sweep selects viable optimization separately from architectural conclusions.
Every attempted learning rate is retained, including failed and early-stopped runs.
A discovery-seed winner is not a promoted claim until repeated over three declared seeds.
KDA and GDN keep the same output-gate rank; GDN sigmoid versus KDA sigmoid isolates decay granularity and its required projection.
Synthetic success gates language-model pretraining but does not imply natural-language long-context capability.
